name: cars
about: Cars checkpoint: road chains and seam crossings, a refused bulldoze, the disconnect and its undo
doc: Cars checkpoint: runs `docs/checkpoints/cars/cars.json` natively at 1280x800 with `--tilt off --clock fixed`: two house clusters joined by a road chain with a 120° bend, cars driving across the tile seams (overview, close-up and seam stills), a refused bulldoze of the middle road, a filler meadow that makes it legal, the bulldoze that disconnects the houses (cars despawn, spawn rate 0) and its undo. Copies JPEG stills and the state dumps to `docs/checkpoints/cars/` (see [Cars](#cars))

name: coast
about: Coast checkpoint (owner O1): a closed island under ten rotations inside an ocean ring, refused beach placements
doc: Coast checkpoint for the directional beach sockets (owner O1): runs `docs/checkpoints/coast/coast.json` natively at 1600x1000 under `caffeinate -d -u` with `--tilt off --clock fixed --water_clock fixed`. An island of four meadows is closed by 12 coast tiles (2 straight beaches, 8 headlands, 2 bays, under 10 tile-rotation pairs) inside a ring of 18 ocean tiles. Before that, three placements are refused and dumped: ocean against a beach edge, grass against a beach edge, and a beach edge against grass. The run writes an overview, headland and bay views, and straight-to-headland seam close-ups (oblique and top-down), and the last headland 59 frames into its rise with its water filling from the base (`coast-08-rise-headland-fill`), and copies JPEG stills and the state dumps to `docs/checkpoints/coast/`. `water::tiles` test `coast_proof_script_closes_an_island` replays the script on the rules

name: elevation
about: Elevation review shots (P4): overview, ramp low and a car burst into the east tunnel portal
doc: Elevation review shots (P4): runs `docs/checkpoints/elevation/elevation-shots.json` (the world of `elevation.json`, then a house at each end of the tunnel road) natively under `caffeinate -d -u` with `--clock fixed --water_clock fixed`: `elevation-overview`, `elevation-ramp-low` and a burst `elevation-car-portal-0..7` with a state dump each (`car_list[].lamps`). Booked load-sensitive window only. The cliff-edge frame reuses `docs/checkpoints/elevation/visual-parity/`; the HUD "Level N" frame (`hud-level.jpg`) comes from `ELEVATION_OUT=docs/checkpoints/elevation node e2e/elevation.mjs dist`, because native shots draw no HUD

name: farm-play
about: Farm tile in play: play distance, barn, hay and animal close-ups, walk views and the paddock fence
doc: Farm tile in play: runs `docs/checkpoints/farm/farm-play.json` natively at 1280x800 under `caffeinate -d -u` with `--tilt off --clock fixed --water_clock fixed`. It places the farm tile among meadows and shoots it at play distance (`farm-play`), the barn and hay close up (`farm-barn`), the cow and sheep close up (`farm-animals`), an eye-level walk view across the pasture to the barn (`farm-walk-eye`), then walks into the barn's front wall and dumps the block (`farm-walk-state.json`: `blocked` `building`, `blocked_by` `barn_red`), then looks along the wall to the hay (`farm-walk-blocked`), then walks from the yard into the paddock fence's north run west of the gate and dumps the block (`farm-walk-fence-state.json`: `blocked` `fence`, `blocked_by` `fence_paddock`) and shoots the fence (`farm-walk-fence`), then walks through the 3 m gate into the paddock (`farm-walk-gate-state.json`: no fence block) and looks toward the animals (`farm-walk-gate`). The farm tile is the barn, three hay bales, a cow and two sheep inside the post-and-rail paddock fence (one `fence_paddock` hero at the tile centre, its gate toward the yard), on the meadow base with wildflowers and rocks. It fails on a black still (an idle display, or an occluded window under `--offscreen off`) and leaves the committed stills alone

name: farm-wander
about: Farm animals wandering (P3): a close pair 10 s apart, the walk inside the paddock, a five-farm world
doc: Farm animals wandering (P3): runs `docs/checkpoints/farm-wander/farm-wander.json` natively at 1280x800 with `--seed 1 --fps off --tilt off --clock fixed --water_clock fixed --diag`: the farm among meadows at play distance, a close pair 10 s apart (600 frames) with each `play.farm` dumped, an eye-level walk view inside the paddock, and a 20-tile world with five farms whose `play.farm` counts and `diag` entities and draws are dumped. Writes JPEG stills and the state dumps to `docs/checkpoints/farm-wander/`

name: grass
about: Grass checkpoint: meadow, verge and border close-ups, a gust, density levels and the place/bulldoze dumps
doc: Grass checkpoint: `docs/checkpoints/grass/grass.json` on the scatter checkpoint's world, natively at 1280x800, High, `--grade rich-3`, `--tilt off --clock fixed --water_clock fixed`: meadow, forest-margin, road-verge and river-bank close-ups, straight-down views across a meadow-meadow and a meadow-forest tile border, an eye-level view (1.7 m), a mid-zoom showing the fade, a gust rolling over the meadows in four frames 75 frames (1.25 s) apart, the eye-level view at 50% and 150%, Low (no grass), and the place, bulldoze and Start over state dumps; `grass-off.json` repeats the eye-level view with `--grass off`. Copies JPEG stills and the dumps to `docs/checkpoints/grass/`. A GPU capture: check the host load is at or below 15 first

runs.args: --scenario play --clock fixed --water_clock fixed --tier high --grade rich-3 --grass off

name: massif
about: Massif review shots (P4 mega tiles): the massif ringed by Meadow with forest edge, road and level-1 neighbour
doc: Massif review shots (P4 mega tiles): runs `docs/checkpoints/massif_granite/massif-shots.json` natively under `caffeinate -d -u` with `--clock fixed --water_clock fixed`. The world is a massif ringed by Meadow with a forest edge on its north side and a road through its east side cell, and a level-1 massif beside level-0 Meadow to the west. Frames: `massif-overview`, `massif-seam-low` (along the ring-to-Meadow seam), `massif-cliff-raised`, `massif-ghost-0` and `-1` (two rotations, with state dumps) and `massif-sink-0` and `-1` (the bulldoze sink), plus `massif-world-state` and `massif-sink-state`. Booked load-sensitive window only. The browser check is `node e2e/massif.mjs dist` (after `make build-web`): place, R, undo, redo and bulldoze through the bridge, asserting the ghost `footprint`, `mega_slots` and the anchor-only `tiles` after each step and the Tiles sheet's massif row against `megaFit`

doc: Open tunnels review shots (P4): runs `docs/checkpoints/open_tunnels/rail-tunnel-shots.json` and `road-tunnel-shots.json` (written by `make_shots.py`) through `scripts/shots/piece.py` under `caffeinate -d -u` with fixed clocks: a rail tunnel down q = 1 and the elevation smoke world's road tunnel, shot as overview, mouth, ridge, the bore from inside with vehicles passing, and a walk view inside it. name: waterfall
about: Waterfall runtime (rivers at levels): the sheet and plunge pool of 1, 2 and 3-level falls and a fall onto a mouth, at High and Low
doc: Waterfall runtime review shots (rivers at levels, Task 11): runs `docs/checkpoints/waterfall/runtime/waterfall.json` natively under `caffeinate -d -u` with `--clock fixed --water_clock fixed`, once at `--tier high` (the sheet refracts within 1.5 m below each tier's lip, RQ5 O2) into `docs/checkpoints/waterfall/runtime/high/` and once at `--tier low` (opaque white with streaks, RQ5 O1) into `docs/checkpoints/waterfall/runtime/low/`. The world is a meadow row with four falls off it along r = -1: 1, 2 and 3-level drops onto `river_straight` and a 1-level drop onto a `river_mouth`. Each fall gets a front view of the sheet (`waterfall-01-drop1`, `-02-drop2`, `-03-drop3`, `-04-onto-mouth`), a lip view (`-lip`) and a plunge-pool view (`-pool`), after an overview (`waterfall-00-overview`), and `waterfall-state.json` is dumped. `hex-app` test `the_waterfall_shots_world_has_its_four_falls` replays the script. Each seam draws its fall face (`waterfall_l1` to `_l3`, Task 19) under the upper tile's root. Every tier's sheet streaks downward, faster toward its foot, which churns white where it lands, and the plunge pool boils (`water.wesl`, all tiers). Each tier landing raises soft camera-facing spray and mist puffs that rise, drift out over the lower tile and fade, the plunge pool a bigger cloud that grows with the drop (owner 2026-11-24; `hex_play::water::mist`, `assets/shaders/fall_mist.wesl`): every fall's puffs are one mesh in one draw, none without a fall, so the thumbnails (`NoFalls`) are unchanged. Puffs per lip landing at Low, Medium, High and Ultra: 3, 5, 8, 12; per plunge pool 5, 8, 12, 16 plus 2, 3, 5, 7 per level of drop. They move as a pure function of the water clock, so `--water_clock fixed` replays them; under reduced motion none are drawn. Booked load-sensitive window only

name: waterfall-ghost
about: River ghost beside a fall (rivers at levels, RQ11 O2): its flow chevrons, and the waterfall marker one R step up
doc: River ghost review shots (rivers at levels, Task 14): runs `docs/checkpoints/waterfall/ghost/waterfall-ghost.json` natively under `caffeinate -d -u` with `--clock fixed --water_clock fixed` into `docs/checkpoints/waterfall/ghost/`. Beside a meadow row, a level-1 `river_straight` at (1, -1) falls onto a level-0 one at (2, -1). A `river_straight` ghost below the fall at (3, -1) shows its flow chevrons, in from the west and out to the east (`waterfall-ghost-01-below-fall`); a ghost above it at (0, -1) on level 1 feeds the raised straight (`-02-above`); one R step lifts it to level 2, a fall onto the raised straight, with world edge 0 in the ghost's `waterfalls` (`-03-fall-marker`). Each shot dumps its state (`play.ghost.flow` and `play.ghost.waterfalls`). `hex-app` test `the_waterfall_ghost_shots_show_the_flow_and_the_fall_marker` replays the script. Named apart from `make shots-ghost` (`e2e/ghost-shots.mjs`), whose explicit rule would shadow a `ghost` row. Booked load-sensitive window only

name: waterfall-staircase
about: Waterfall staircase (rivers at levels): three 1-level falls down one river, levels 3, 2, 1, 0, beside the mixed river, beach and ocean scatter world
doc: Waterfall staircase review shots (rivers at levels, Task 15): runs `docs/checkpoints/waterfall/staircase/waterfall-staircase.json` natively under `caffeinate -d -u` with `--clock fixed --water_clock fixed` into `docs/checkpoints/waterfall/staircase/`. The world is the mixed river, beach and ocean world of `make shots-scatter` (forest, oak, meadow, road; 34 tiles, all level 0, no fall) plus a meadow row at r = -3 (q 3 to 8) and a river_straight staircase along r = -4 at q 5, 6, 7, 8 on levels 3, 2, 1, 0. Shots: an overview of the whole world (`waterfall-staircase-00-overview`), then per fall a front view, a lip view (`-lip`) and a plunge-pool view (`-pool`) for the 3 to 2, 2 to 1 and 1 to 0 falls (`waterfall-staircase-01-fall3to2`, `-02-fall2to1`, `-03-fall1to0`), and the whole 12 m staircase from the side (`-04-full`). `waterfall-staircase-state.json` is dumped. `hex-app` test `the_waterfall_staircase_world_is_the_mixed_world_plus_three_falls` replays the script. e2e/perf-close-camera.mjs and e2e/perf-close-camera-native.mjs read its placements as the `staircase` world. Booked load-sensitive window only

name: wheat-play
about: Wheat field tile in play: seam and sun/shade close-ups, scale shot, eye level, the walk into the field
doc: Wheat field tile in play: runs `docs/checkpoints/wheat_field/wheat-play.json` natively at 1280x800 with `--tilt off --clock fixed --water_clock fixed`. It places two wheat fields one row apart, the farm and meadows, and shoots play distance (`wheat-play`), the seams with the grass margin and the second field (`wheat-seam`), sun-side and shade-side close-ups (`wheat-close-sun`, then `wheat-close-sun-1s` 60 frames later for the wind sway, `wheat-close-shade`), a scale shot across the wheat to the barn (`wheat-scale`), eye level in walk mode (`wheat-walk-eye`), then walks 9 s into the field and dumps the state (`wheat-walk-state.json`: `blocked` null, the walker stands on the earth) and shoots it (`wheat-walk-inside`). It fails on a black still and copies JPEG stills and the dumps to `docs/checkpoints/wheat_field/`; `python3 docs/checkpoints/wheat_field/sheet.py` builds the review sheet

name: windmill-play
about: Windmill tile in play: two frames 1 s apart and a blocked walk into the tower
doc: Windmill tile in play: runs `docs/checkpoints/windmill/windmill-play.json` natively at 1280x800 under `caffeinate -d -u` with `--tilt off --clock fixed --water_clock fixed`. It places the windmill tile among meadows and an oak, shoots it twice 60 frames apart (`windmill-play`, `windmill-play-1s`: the sails turn 24° at 4 rpm), then walks into the tower and dumps the block (`windmill-walk-state.json`: `blocked` `building`, `blocked_by` `windmill`) and looks up from its foot (`windmill-walk-blocked`). It fails on a black still (an idle display, or an occluded window under `--offscreen off`) and copies JPEG stills and the dumps to `docs/checkpoints/windmill/`
